name: Sasori
background: Sasori, known as Sasori of the Red Sand, was a legendary puppet master from Sunagakure. After his parents' death, he became obsessed with creating puppets, leading him to transform his own body into one. As a member of Akatsuki, Sasori partnered with Deidara, blending their contrasting philosophies of art. Sasori's abilities allowed him to take down entire nations with his vast arsenal of puppets.

abilities.name: Human Puppet Creation
abilities.description: Transforms the corpses of powerful shinobi into puppets, allowing them to retain their chakra and abilities.

abilities.name: Puppet Technique
abilities.description: Manipulates puppets with threads of chakra for offense, defense, and support.

abilities.name: Performance of a Hundred Puppets
abilities.description: Controls up to 100 puppets simultaneously, a feat that allowed Sasori to destroy an entire nation.

abilities.name: Iron Sand Techniques
abilities.description: Using the Third Kazekage puppet, Sasori manipulates iron sand for large-scale attacks.

abilities.name: Hiruko
abilities.description: A puppet armor that provides both defense and offense with its mechanical enhancements.

abilities.name: Eternal Puppet Body
abilities.description: Sasori's self-modified puppet body grants him immortality, immunity to aging, and numerous hidden weapons.

relationships.name: Chiyo
relationships.dynamic: Grandmother and fellow puppet master. Their relationship was strained after Sasori defected from Sunagakure.

relationships.name: Deidara
relationships.dynamic: Partner in Akatsuki. Sasori and Deidara often debated over their differing philosophies of art.

relationships.name: Kankurō
relationships.dynamic: A fellow puppet master from Sunagakure. Sasori passed on his parents' puppets to Kankurō before his death.

quotes.text: Since I don't like to wait or make people wait… I'll end this quickly.
quotes.context: To Kankurō, displaying his efficiency in combat.

quotes.text: For my name to be known all the way down to a kid like you… is an honour.
What? You call those explosions fine art? Fine art is something wonderful that's left long into the future… eternal beauty.
quotes.context: To Deidara, contrasting their views on art.

quotes.text: Great puppet masters think alike, I suppose.
quotes.context: Commenting on Chiyo's skills during their battle.

quotes.text: That is a considerable amount of puppets. But… [Proceeds to summon one hundred puppets of his own] With these, I took down a whole nation!
quotes.context: To Chiyo, boasting about his strength.

quotes.text: How'll I explain this… How long it took me to take down a little girl and an old hag… That I even had to use my last trick…
quotes.context: Reflecting on his battle with Chiyo and Sakura.

quotes.text: Women like to do useless things don't they… Even connected by blood ties as we are, I won't feel a thing if grandma dies here. My heart… is just like this body…
quotes.context: To Sakura, showing his detachment from emotions.

quotes.text: Want to try to become like this too? If you do then you'll probably get what I'm saying. A body that does not decay… a puppet body can be rebuilt over and over… unfettered by a mortal lifespan.
quotes.context: Offering Sakura a glimpse into his philosophy.

quotes.text: I would describe myself as a human being who could not become a complete puppet, I am an unfinished puppet, whose lifeless frame still contains a beating heart at its core. I am neither dead, nor am I alive.
My old puppet body… Suddenly it all seems so pointless. I now have the body I've always desired, one that will never rot or decay. I've truly become a puppet in every sense of the word.
quotes.context: Upon seeing Kankurō using his old puppet body.

quotes.text: Kankurō… I want you to have my 'Mother' and 'Father' puppets as well… and when you die, pass them both on… to the next generation.
quotes.context: Last words to Kankurō, showing a rare moment of sentiment.
